local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local before=nil
local consumed,healed=false,false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function()
 local inv=Actor.inventory(self)
 local id=core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x9310)
 local health=Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current
 if not before then before=health assert(inv:countOf(id)==3,'Healing potion missing') print('Substructure healing ready health='..health) end
 if not consumed and inv:countOf(id)==1 then consumed=true print('Substructure healing potion consumed') end
 if consumed and not healed and health>before then healed=true print('Substructure potion restored health from='..before..' to='..health) end
end}}}}
